name: Farmhouse Style Furniture - Custom Furniture & Kitchen Cabinets | White Bear Lake
old_description: At our core, we have a simple mission: to create handcrafted furniture that is both desirable and affordable. We understand the frustration of searching endlessly for the perfect piece, only to find it either out of reach financially or needing more quality. That’s why we have made it our goal to redefine the concept of “affordable furniture” by offering timeless, unique, and durable pieces made from solid wood. Our commitment extends beyond simply providing furniture. We deeply care about our community and have identified a genuine need for high-quality furniture at an accessible price point. By doing so, we aim to bring the beauty and craftsmanship of our pieces to a broader audience within our community and beyond.
about:
Farmhouse Style Furniture operates from White Bear Township, Minnesota. The business traces its start to 2012 when founder James Putnam built a dining table for a friend, sparking demand for his custom woodworking. By 2017 Putnam left his previous job to pursue the craft full time, and the company now runs as a family-owned shop with James Putnam, Nathan Glenz, and Trevor Putnam the team.

The shop produces custom furniture and cabinetry for kitchens, bathrooms, mudrooms, and living rooms. Every piece is handcrafted from solid wood — oak, cherry, maple, or walnut — using traditional joinery such as dovetail, mortise-and-tenon, and tongue-and-groove joints. The workflow follows a four-step collaboration: design consultation, detailed planning, precision handcrafting, and final installation. A showroom on site lets clients review materials and finishes before production begins.

The customer base is residential homeowners seeking made-to-fit pieces. Recent projects cited in reviews include a sewing cabinet, a bathroom vanity, a mudroom hall tree, a pandemic-era homeschooling table and benches that became a permanent dining set, dining chairs delivered ahead of schedule, a hall-tree entry piece, a dining table with bar stools, and bedroom suites with beds, dressers, and hallway storage.

The company states its mission is to redefine affordable furniture by offering timeless, one-of-a-kind pieces built to last. Putnam emphasizes that the business exists to meet a community need for high-quality, accessible craftsmanship, turning each client's vision into a durable, personalized product.

name: Farmville Wholesale Electric Supply Co., Inc.
old_description: Farmville Wholesale Electric was founded in 1972 by Lynwood G. Smith of Farmville, Virginia. Mr. Smith, widely known as "Linnie", and his two brothers had previously established a contracting and retail firm known as Smitty Brothers Electric Company, which they owned for over forty years following World War II.  It was always Mr. Smith's dream, however, to be involved in the electrical business at the wholesale level.  That dream was realized through his two sons with the formation of FWESCO in 1972.  Mr. Smith went home to the Lord on January 17th, 2004.  He is dearly missed by all who knew him.
about:
Farmville Wholesale Electric Supply Co., Inc. operates from Farmville, Virginia, where it was founded in 1972 by Lynwood G. Smith, known locally as "Linnie." Smith and his two brothers had previously run Smitty Brothers Electric Company, a contracting and retail firm they owned for over four decades after World War II. Smith's long-held ambition to enter the wholesale electrical market was realized through his two sons with the formation of FWESCO.

The company functions as a wholesale electrical distributor with a 4,000-square-foot showroom and a dedicated sales counter. Its product range spans lighting fixtures such as chandeliers, ceiling fans, and outdoor lighting, along with a full line of electrical supplies. A virtual showroom allows customers to preview fixtures and layouts online before visiting in person.

The business serves both residential and commercial customers, including contractors and homeowners seeking lighting design assistance or electrical materials. Walk-in trade and project-based orders are handled through the sales counter, which offers wholesale pricing.

The company emphasizes personalized service from a knowledgeable staff, wholesale pricing, and the convenience of both a physical showroom and an online virtual tour as key differentiators.

name: Fashions Unlimited Inc.
old_description: Fashions Unlimited is a full-service apparel manufacturer based in Baltimore, Maryland that has been serving a variety of clientele since 1976.
about:
Fashions Unlimited was founded in 1976 by Phil Spector in Baltimore, Maryland, after he spent a decade working for another local manufacturer. The company remains a privately held, founder-led operation specializing in domestic apparel production.

The facility focuses on activewear, intimate apparel, and swimwear constructed from stretch fabrics. Services span product development, pattern making using AccuMark digital software, 3D digital rendering, cutting on a Gerber automatic cutter, and sewing with overlock, coverstitch, flatlock, zig-zag, and single-needle lockstitch machines. Finishing includes tagging, bagging, and bulk shipping, while repair work covers retagging and rebagging. Production minimums start at 200 pieces per style, with a typical initial order of 300 pieces across multiple colors and sizes.

Clients range from startup brands needing full development to established labels supplying their own patterns and materials. The company has produced for recognized national brands, including Miss Daisy Medical, and serves the activewear, intimate-apparel, and swimwear markets. Material sourcing is limited to domestic suppliers.

Spector’s 50-plus years of industry experience and the firm’s status as one of the few remaining onshore cut-and-sew facilities underpin its positioning. The 3D rendering capability—rare among Maryland manufacturers—aims to reduce sample iterations, and the AccuMark system drives fabric efficiency through digital markers.

name: Fehrer Automotive
old_description: Wir sind einer der weltweit führenden Spezialisten für Komponenten im Fahrzeuginnenraum.
about:
Fehrer Automotive, the U.S. subsidiary of the German Fehrer Group, operates from Gadsden, Alabama, while the group's global headquarters is in Kitzingen, Germany. The company is part of the AUNDE Group, which ranks among the world's top 100 automotive suppliers.

Fehrer develops and manufactures interior components for passenger vehicles, including seat cushions, seat modules, and lightweight composite structures made from fiber-reinforced plastics. The company provides full-service support from concept through series production, employing more than 50 CAD workstations and maintaining on-site service centers at major OEM locations to enable direct engineering collaboration. Prototyping capabilities include CNC milling.

The company serves automotive OEMs and tier-one suppliers worldwide, with a focus on vehicle interior systems.

Fehrer emphasizes a "full service from a single source" model, combining design, tooling, and production under one roof. Quality management is certified to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and IATF 16949 standards, reflecting a commitment to consistent process control.

name: Fernwood Designs Woodworking
old_description: Located in the Blue Ridge Mountains of  Western North Carolina, Rich Grenier is the owner/creator of Fernwood Designs.  His shop is tucked away on a peaceful parcel of land where he lives with his wife and artist
about:
Fernwood Designs operates from a woodworking shop in Mars Hill, North Carolina, nestled in the Blue Ridge Mountains of Western North Carolina. Owner and creator Rich Grenier runs the business with his wife, artist Francine D’Antuono, from a property where a path through the woods leads to the shop and provides daily inspiration. The company’s founding year is not publicly stated.

The shop is equipped for a range of custom woodwork: cabinetry, furniture spanning farmhouse rustic to refined urban styles, counter and table tops, built-in units, tongue-and-groove milling for flooring and ceilings, lathe-turned legs and trim, milling and sanding of raw lumber up to 50 inches wide, epoxy and stone inlays, fine art frames, interior and exterior doors, and trim and moulding. Francine D’Antuono contributes design services, producing detailed drawings and plans for projects from full kitchens to single pieces.

Fernwood Designs serves clients seeking custom cabinetry, furniture, architectural millwork, and artistic wood pieces. The company works with a wide variety of wood species, from exotic lumbers to reclaimed boards salvaged from old structures, treating each piece as a unique work of art.

Rich Grenier emphasizes preserving the natural character of each wood selection, assembling pieces to keep the material’s unique qualities true. The collaborative design process, combining Rich’s craftsmanship with Francine’s artistic drawings, is presented as a core differentiator for the business.

name: Ferraro Foods of North Carolina
old_description: EXCLUSIVE BRANDS AND PRODUCTS DESIGNED WITH OUR CUSTOMERS IN MIND
about:
Ferraro Foods traces its roots to 1975, when founder Ferraro established the business in Greenbrook, New Jersey. Named after its original owner, the company began as an Italian-focused food distributor with a mission to deliver quality products and reliable service. Today the operation is headquartered in Mebane, North Carolina.

The company operates as a broad-line foodservice distributor, stocking thousands of items that range from pasta, premium cheeses, and tomatoes to flour, beverages, meats, seafood, appetizers, desserts, and packaging such as pizza boxes and food containers. Its logistics network includes multi-temperature trucks and refrigerated loading docks designed to maintain product integrity across the supply chain. Ferraro Foods serves more than 8,000 customers across 26 states.

Its customer base spans a variety of foodservice operators, including restaurants, institutional kitchens, and other businesses that require consistent access to Italian and specialty food products. The distributor also offers an online ordering platform and publishes a monthly product bulletin called FRESCO to highlight new additions.

Ferraro Foods emphasizes product integrity and reliable delivery as its core differentiators, stating that every piece of equipment from loading dock to truck is held to the same high standards to meet customer expectations.

name: Findlay Food Coatings
old_description: Findlay Food Coatings can design and blend innovative and individualized recipes for you, our customer.
about:
Findlay Food Coatings operates from Caldwell, Idaho, where its state-of-the-art facility was commissioned in January 2015. The U.S. entity was established in 2013 as part of the Findlay Family Group, a fourth-generation family business with over 100 years of history that began as a local bread bakery on the East Coast of New Zealand. In the 1990s the group expanded into manufacturing Panko breadcrumbs, conventional breadcrumbs, and batter coating systems, later building powder blending sites in Idaho to serve the North American market.

The company designs and blends custom food coating recipes, producing premixes, batter washes, pre-dusts, clear coats, flour-based French fry batters, adhesion batters, and tempura batters. Its Caldwell plant runs automated powder blending lines, backed by a secondary site in Nampa, while additional manufacturing facilities in Gisborne, Dunedin, and Auckland, New Zealand, and Bathurst, Australia, support global operations.

Findlay serves the food coatings industry, developing systems to coat substrates ranging from proteins to vegetables, with a focus on French fry applications. Its customer base consists of a select group of food manufacturers that engage the company for new product development and cost-reduction initiatives on existing lines.

The business emphasizes innovation, reliability, and consistency, positioning itself as a partner that delivers on its promises. Customers are drawn to its ability to think outside the box and provide cost-effective, tailored coating solutions backed by a technical team with worldwide expertise.
